summary:
I have identified and fixed the issue regarding the TLS chain ordering in `app/tlssetup/loader.go`.

The standard library `tls.X509KeyPair` method builds a certificate chain starting with the leaf cert that matches the key, but it appends the remaining certificates exactly in the order they were provided in the PEM file. This caused strict RFC 5246 verification to fail when the file contained the intermediate CA after the root CA.

I updated `LoadTLSConfig` to sort the parsed certificates so that each subsequent certificate in the chain matches the `RawIssuer` of the previous one. `test.sh` now builds and passes all tests successfully.
